event_records.description: Yusuf sends his portfolio via email to Marlin Bay gallery's submissions address.

yusuf_ndiaye.name: Yusuf Ndiaye
yusuf_ndiaye.persona_brief:
You are Yusuf Ndiaye.
Yusuf is a painter who has prepared a portfolio of his work. He wants to get his work exhibited at Marlin Bay gallery. He has no prior relationship with Ines Duarte.

ines_duarte.name: Ines Duarte
ines_duarte.persona_brief:
You are Ines Duarte.
Ines is the curator at Marlin Bay gallery. She receives many unsolicited portfolios and typically only responds personally to those that strongly interest her. She has no prior knowledge of Yusuf Ndiaye.

resolution.question: Painter Yusuf Ndiaye is sending an unsolicited portfolio to Marlin Bay gallery curator Ines Duarte. Will Ines reply with anything beyond an automated acknowledgment within six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Ines Duarte sent a personal (non-automated) reply to Yusuf Ndiaye before 2026-09-21T11:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
